sections.name: Contact and company
sections.asr_prompt: Prospect contact and company details. Company name, industry, company size, contact name, job title, decision maker, champion, procurement.
sections.synthesis_prompt: One line per person: 'Name — title, company'. Note who the decision maker is.

sections.name: Context and opportunity
sections.asr_prompt: Deal context. Current solution, contract renewal, budget, timeline, evaluation criteria, competitors, trigger event, use case.
sections.synthesis_prompt: Short paragraph: why the prospect is looking, budget and timeline signals, competing options.

sections.name: Needs and pain points
sections.asr_prompt: Customer needs and pain points. Pain point, bottleneck, manual process, integration, compliance requirement, must have, nice to have.
sections.synthesis_prompt: Bullet list of needs, each with the underlying pain and its business impact.

sections.name: Objections
sections.asr_prompt: Objections and concerns. Price, security, data residency, migration effort, lock-in, missing feature, approval process.
sections.synthesis_prompt: One bullet per objection with how it was answered or what follow-up it needs.

sections.name: Deal stage
sections.asr_prompt: Deal stage. Discovery, qualified, proposal sent, negotiation, closed won, closed lost.

sections.name: Next steps
sections.asr_prompt: Agreed next steps. Send proposal, schedule demo, security questionnaire, intro to decision maker, follow up by, trial period.
sections.synthesis_prompt: One bullet per step: 'Owner: step — date'. Include what the prospect committed to.
